categories.main_business_segments: Jiayuan Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in network information security products and integrated information technology solutions, focusing on defense military industry, healthcare, and government services sectors. The company also provides technical services including software development, project implementation, and system integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced coding theory and artificial intelligence for network security, including proprietary encoding and AI-optimized security models. It develops commercial cryptography products based on PCIe bus with domestic CPU and FPGA architectures. Production involves both in-house manufacturing and qualified outsourcing for non-core processes, with a matrix management system for R&D projects. The company also develops high-performance distributed database and computing technologies for its information solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national defense and military enterprises, healthcare institutions such as hospitals, and government agencies. The company serves specialized industries requiring high security and information integration, including aerospace, aviation, and ground security sectors. Major clients include Shanghai Aerospace Technology Research Institute and China Electronics Technology Group.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiayuan Technology operates mainly in China with significant revenue from North China, Southwest China, and East China regions. Its headquarters and main operations are based in Chengdu High-tech Zone, with subsidiaries in Beijing, Shanghai, and Hebei. The company’s market coverage is nationwide, focusing on strategic regions with government and military presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the network security and information technology supply chain. It develops and manufactures core security hardware and software products and provides integrated IT solutions and services directly to end customers in specialized sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing network information security technologies, especially in coding and AI applications, commercial cryptography, and secure computing platforms for aerospace and defense. The company emphasizes R&D in high-performance distributed computing, medical big data security, AI integration in healthcare, and development of proprietary SIP chips. It plans to expand standardized product lines and enhance production capabilities with smart manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of network security products, integrated information technology solutions via project-based contracts, and technical service fees. The company secures orders primarily through competitive bidding and contract fulfillment, with payments tied to project milestones and final acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayuan Technology holds a competitive position in China's specialized network security market, particularly in defense and aerospace sectors. It benefits from strong government recognition and certifications, with a focus on proprietary technology and integrated solutions. The company competes with other domestic network security and IT service providers but differentiates through its combined hardware-software capabilities and strategic industry focus.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 337 million, a 48.11% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.45 million, reversing prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 1.53 billion, growing 7.52%. The company maintains a moderate asset-liability ratio of 13.72%, with sustained R&D investment around 18.74% of revenue, supporting steady growth and technological advancement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayuan Technology emphasizes its proprietary coding and AI-enhanced network security technologies, combined with integrated hardware-software platforms tailored for high-security sectors like defense and healthcare. Its value proposition includes high reliability, security, and performance of products validated in aerospace applications, alongside comprehensive information solutions that improve operational efficiency and data security for clients. The company’s full industry chain coverage and strong R&D capabilities enable customized, innovative solutions that meet stringent national security and industry standards.
